metadata.datasource: Measured off HARMAN technology, ILFORD DELTA 100 PROFESSIONAL technical information (Nov 2018), roll film (as representative of 35 mm and sheet film), ID-11 stock 8 1/2 min at 20 C, intermittent agitation. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 100; base + fog 0.071. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Ilford's wedge spectrogram to tungsten light, read as relative log sensitivity, as HP5 Plus's; Ortho Plus's own ratings, ISO 80 to daylight and 40 to tungsten, bear the reading out. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
